summary: Move the shared catalog generation reader family into a private leaf module while preserving its existing paths.

replay.detail: The four function bodies and their error handling are unchanged; no replay or state write changes.

schema.detail: The control directory, generation filename and newline-terminated counter format remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Authoring locks, generation fences, incomplete markers and reader validation retain their existing behavior.

compatibility.detail: The leaf module is private. Existing catalog_lock constant and function paths remain through re-exports, including native message, resource-observe and runner callers.

downtime.detail: An internal code move requires no new restart or service interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action or migration. This prerequisite does not retire catalog writers or compatibility callers.

recovery.detail: No state conversion; reverting restores the previous source layout without changing persisted files.
